integrity: Analytic proof supplied; exact rational verifier plus direct finite graph construction; no independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-dimensional sample, fixed k=2, union-symmetrized graph only. The general central limit theorem is pre-existing, and no independent full text comparison to the Penrose-Yukich (2001) paper was possible. Exact finite laws and component-size distributions are not claimed.
title: Exact cut-gap covariance and a rational variance law for one-dimensional two-nearest-neighbor graphs
